About Aatmyam Pos

Aatmyam Pos is early-access software for independent restaurants and cafés in India. It brings orders, kitchen progress, bills, ingredients and staff access into one place, with one outlet for each restaurant account.

Our focus is the work your team does every day: taking orders, keeping the kitchen informed, checking stock and giving staff the right access. See Product and Pricing for the features and allowances currently available.

This Privacy Policy details how Aatmyam Pos collects, utilizes, and secures data related to your restaurant operations. Your privacy is paramount, and we deploy multi-tenant segmentation to ensure that other business establishments cannot view or query your operational data.
Restaurant details: restaurant name, email address, area and registered Owner’s name.
Orders and payments: bills, amounts, table numbers, cashier names and the recorded payment method, Cash or UPI.
Stock and recipes: ingredients, stock counts, chosen low-stock levels, purchase costs and recipe quantities.
Staff details: active staff lists, protected sign-in details and recorded working hours.
Guest details: phone numbers and loyalty points entered by your restaurant during billing.
